title: Oakland County page listing Sean Carlson is stale
summary: A dated departure report supersedes the undated county contact page for current-role purposes.

data.claim: Sean Carlson left his Oakland County deputy-executive role on April 7, 2026; the county contact page still listing him should not be treated as current employment evidence.
data.adjudication: Prefer the dated departure report until Oakland County publishes a newer official appointment or correction.
